#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug


#### What this PR does / why we need it:

See https://kubernetes.slack.com/archives/C0BP8PW9G/p1785963715244149

We have three unresolved critical issue and disabling the feature by default will be a better option at this stage of a release process.

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

Some test lanes MAY expect it the be enabled by default. I hope not, but there may be failures cause by it. Let's keep eye on those.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
The feature gate `PodLevelResourceManagers` is disabled by default.
```
KEP: https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/issues/5526
